Run the reinsurance pricing application

Source: R/reinsurance_pricing_tool_global.R
run_shiny_reinsurance_pricing_tool.Rd

Opens NetTreaty, a shiny application for pricing an excess of loss layer: it rates the layer on its loss experience, with the burning cost and a Pareto model of the large losses, and on its exposure, with a risk profile and an MBBEFD exposure curve (property) or a claim size distribution (casualty), blends the two with a credibility weight, and gives the technical premium, with reinstatements, rate on line and payback.

Usage

run_shiny_reinsurance_pricing_tool()

Value

A shiny app object. Printing it, as happens when the function is called at the console, opens the application; it can also be passed to shiny::runApp().

See also

burning_cost, pareto_rating, property_exposure_rating, casualty_exposure_rating and technical_premium, the methods of the application; run_shiny_simulator, run_shiny_distribution_fitting_tool, run_shiny_glm_fitting_tool and run_shiny_reserving_tool, the package's other applications.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  run_shiny_reinsurance_pricing_tool()
}
